name: Mahlkönig E64
author: Decaid contributors
description: Read-only Mahlkönig E64 grinder telemetry over WebSocket.

InstancesJson.label: E64 instances
InstancesJson.description: JSON array of id, name, scheme, host, port, and optional pollMs.

TokensJson.label: E64 session tokens
TokensJson.description: JSON object mapping instance ids to WebSocket tokens.

MintTokens.label: Mint tokens on connect
MintTokens.description: When true, empty TokensJson entries are filled by logging in on each connect. Requires PasswordsJson or AllowNoPasswordWorkaround.

PasswordsJson.label: E64 Owner passwords
PasswordsJson.description: JSON object mapping instance ids to the current Owner password. Stored as a secure setting and never logged.

AllowNoPasswordWorkaround.label: Allow no-password workaround
AllowNoPasswordWorkaround.description: Use the documented FW-01 SELECT-only login construction when no Owner password is set. This is an authentication bypass; enable only on an owner-controlled device. Default false.
